channel.title: MemRadar
channel.description: Guides, explainers and reference data on RAM and SSD prices, argued from a decade of tracked retail price history.

item.title: How MemRadar Tracks Prices
item.description: How MemRadar collects, stores and interprets prices for 235 RAM and SSD products, where the data comes from, and what it cannot tell you.

item.title: Memory Price Data for Journalists
item.description: Retail price data on 235 RAM and SSD products, free to cite with attribution. Current findings, how to cite, and custom cuts on request.

item.title: RAM & SSD Spec Glossary: Every Term Defined
item.description: Every RAM and SSD spec MemRadar reads off a listing, in plain English: DDR generation, CAS latency, NVMe and SATA, TLC and QLC, PCIe generation and more.

item.title: Should I Buy an SSD Now? (2026 Data, Not Vibes)
item.description: SSD prices are up more than 120% year over year. What a decade of tracked price history says about waiting, and how to spot a fair drive price today.

item.title: Should I Buy RAM Now? (2026 Data, Not Vibes)
item.description: Should you buy RAM now? DDR5 is up +352.3% year over year and still grinding higher. What a decade of real price data says about buying in this market.

item.title: Why Is RAM So Expensive in 2026?
item.description: Why is RAM so expensive in 2026? AI demand took the DRAM capacity and prices multiplied. 206 of 235 tracked products sit at 1.5x their all-time low or more.

item.title: RAM & SSD Price Index: Memory Price Trends
item.description: DDR5 is up +352.3% year over year. Median price changes across 235 tracked RAM and SSD products, from live price history. Updated daily.
